sources.title: Ministral 3 8B - docs.mistral.ai
sources.snippet: Ministral 3 8B is a powerful and efficient model in the Ministral 3 family, offering best-in-class text and vision capabilities. Built for edge deployment, it delivers high performance across diverse hardware, including local setups.

sources.snippet: Ministral3 Overview A balanced model in the Ministral 3 family, Ministral 3 8B is a powerful, efficient tiny language model with vision capabilities. This model is the instruct post-trained version, fine-tuned for instruction tasks, making it ideal for chat and instruction based use cases.

sources.title: [2601.08584] Ministral 3 - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We introduce the Ministral 3 series, a family of parameter-efficient dense language models designed for compute and memory constrained applications, available in three model sizes: 3B, 8B, and 14B parameters. For each model size, we release three variants: a pretrained base model for general-purpose use, an instruction finetuned, and a reasoning model for complex problem-solving. In addition ...
